name: bank_of_canada_valet-mcp
description: Bank of Canada Valet (market data): search_symbols, get_series. Every tool maps to a documented endp

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Every Valet series (about 15,000: exchange rates FX..., bond yields, BCPI ...); query matches the name, label or description; paged locally from one cached download.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: series_id is one Valet series name, e.g. FXUSDCAD (daily USD/CAD), V39079 (overnight target rate). start/end are YYYY-MM-DD; without them the whole history is returned.
